findings.text: non-blocking: `except CrewError: continue` treats every read_pointer failure as 'this run has been reconciled', including the invalid-JSON and non-object branches of read_pointer (reckon/crew/runs.py:850-857). A pointer that is unreadable rather than absent therefore drops the reconcile duty and leaves the request waiting with no remedy; the previous behaviour at least raised a duty. Narrowing to the FileNotFoundError-derived 'no live run' case would keep the intent while not masking a corrupt pointer.
